Greedy minus recal is -25.6, -2.6, +0.9 and 0.0 pp at 5, 10, 25 and 50%. Greedy minus fixed is -23.2 and -8.8 pp at 5% and 10%, and about 0 at 25% and 50%. The learned arm is never above either baseline by more than 1 pp, so claim 2 is not_supported. L7a repeats this at equal labels (-2.1 and -3.4 pp). So the free-label confound is controlled and W2 is false. For claim 3, the only embedding AUC and neighbor-ratio result is E01. Every later entry uses the same model, task and proxy, so none can kill claim 3. It stays open, and W3 is false.

G01 compares the learned allocator against label-free fixed and recalibrated thresholds at equal verifier-call budget, with no free labels. Learned minus fixed is −23.2 pp at 5% and −8.8 pp at 10%, and ties at 25% and 50%. The result held on 16 splits. L7a at equal labels is also negative (−2.06 and −3.35 pp). That meets not_supported, and the free-label confound is controlled, so W2 is false. For claim 3, only E01 reports embedding AUC and neighbor ratio. No non-E01 entry on a different model, task or proxy reports them, and the prompt-space tests were never run. So claim 3 is open, and W3 is false.

Claim 2: G01 compares the learned greedy allocator with label-free fixed and recal thresholds at matched budgets. Neither gets free labels. Greedy minus recal is -25.6, -2.6, +0.9 and 0.0 pp at 5, 10, 25 and 50%, so it favors the fixed rule or ties. L7a repeats this at equal labels: learned minus frozen table is -2.06 and -3.35 pp. The free-label confound is controlled, so W2 is false. Claim 3: only E01 reports embedding AUC (0.922 vs 0.923) and neighbor ratio (about 1.0). Every later entry uses the same model, task and proxy and reports no embedding statistics. That gives no qualifying non-E01 kill, so c3 is open. The ledger holds claim 3 as not supported, so W3 is false.
